name: notarize
description: Apple code signing, notarization, certificates, provisioning profiles, entitlements, Gatekeeper/sandbox/TCC debugging, TestFlight and App Store Connect — an MCP server plus a core skill that takes any macOS or iOS app from zero to shipped.

ASC_KEY_ID.description: App Store Connect API key ID. Optional: a saved profile works instead.

ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.description: Path to the .p8 private key (or ASC_PRIVATE_KEY for its contents).

ASC_PROFILE.description: Name of a saved credential profile.

NOTARIZE_MCP_FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT.description: URL of an mcp-feedback ingest hub. When set, agents can report problems with this server's tools there, each report confirmed by the user first. Unset, MCP_FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT is used; with neither, feedback is off.

MCP_FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT.description: The same, shared by every MCP server that reads it, so one setting covers them all.

MCP_FEEDBACK_DISABLED.description: 1 turns feedback off whatever endpoint is set.

listing.shortDescription: Sign, notarize and ship Apple apps
listing.longDescription: Takes a macOS or iOS app from "I have an app" to a signed, notarized download, a TestFlight build or an App Store submission, for someone with zero Apple-platform context. Covers Xcode, SwiftPM, Electron, Tauri, Flutter, React Native/Expo and prebuilt .app/.dmg/.pkg/.ipa artifacts, and debugs the hard parts: entitlements, Gatekeeper ("app is damaged"), App Sandbox denials, TCC privacy permissions, notarization rejections and ITMS upload errors. Every action that changes anything returns a preview and a confirm token first, and long operations hand off to background jobs instead of blocking.
defaultPrompts: Notarize my Mac app and staple the ticket
Debug why macOS says my app is damaged
Set up my App Store Connect API key
